# NoTime Storage

> College storage made simple. Door-to-door pickup from your dorm, climate-controlled summer storage, and delivery back to your room.

## What We Do

NoTime Storage provides stress-free storage for college students. We pick up belongings from dorm rooms at move-out, store them in a climate-controlled warehouse over the summer, and deliver them back to the new room at move-in. No lugging boxes to a facility — we handle everything.

## Key Facts

- **Service**: Door-to-door pickup and delivery for college students
- **Storage**: Climate-controlled, secure warehouse
- **Box size**: 40″ × 30″ × 30″ (225 lbs max, 20.8 ft³ per box)
- **Schools served**: Stonehill College, University of New Haven, University of Dayton, University of Massachusetts, Brevard College, Gordon College, Central Connecticut State University, Sacred Heart University, Towson University, University of Notre Dame, James Madison University, Bridgewater State University
- **Website**: https://notimestorage.co
- **Contact**: https://notimestorage.co/contact

## Common Questions

**How does move-out pickup work?** You choose a date and time slot. Our team comes to your dorm, loads your belongings into our truck, and takes them to our warehouse. Each pickup takes about 5 minutes.

**How does move-in delivery work?** At checkout you select your move-in date. We deliver your belongings directly to your new room when the semester starts.

**What counts as a box?** Large containers (40″ × 30″ × 30″) that fit a full dorm room's worth of belongings. Mini-fridges, fans, rugs, and chairs are add-ons.

**Pricing?** Based on number of boxes and add-ons. $50 deposit at booking; remaining balance before pickup. Monthly payment plan available (3 installments).

**Schools not listed?** Sign up for the reminder list at https://notimestorage.co — we'll notify you when we launch at your campus.
